newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen securities office warns brokers on locals.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen securities office warns brokers on locals.

text.p: Shenzhen securities authorities have warned brokerages in the southern Chinese city not to allow local investors to buy B shares unless the money comes from outside the country, an official said on Wednesday.

The official told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin that the notice had been passed to the securities houses at the request of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) and the central bank.

"The Shenzhen Securities Management Office has issued notices to local brokerages to ban mainland Chinese whose funds do not come from abroad from buying B shares," said a senior official at the local securities regulatory body.
